name: Overcoming The World
overview: Scripture reveals that overcoming the world is rooted in trusting fully in the Lord rather than our own understanding, as Proverbs 3:5 encourages. Jesus assures believers in John 16:33 that despite tribulation in the world, they can take heart because He has already overcome it. This victory is extended to believers who, through submission to God, resistance to the devil, and reliance on the blood of the Lamb and their testimony, become more than conquerors (Romans 8:37; James 4:7; Revelation 12:11). Ultimately, overcoming the world leads to a profound reward: sharing in Christ’s throne, as promised in Revelation 3:21.
